newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP seen mining 24 mln oz silver/yr.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP seen mining 24 mln oz silver/yr.

text.p: Australia's Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd is poised to lift its output of silver to 24 million ounces by 1999 from virtually zero, brokerage J.B Were and Son said.

In a research report prepared by analyst Neil Goodwill dated August 1996, Were said development by BHP of the Cannington silver, lead and zinc mine, scheduled to commence operation in mid-1997, will provide the company with the world's largest silver mine.
In 1998, silver output from the mine is put at eight million ounces by the brokerage.
The project, located in north-west Queensland, will provide revenue of about A$565 million a year and contribute an estimated A$67 million to BHP's bottom line, J B Were said.
BHP said earlier this year it had already sold most of its output from Cannington to customers in Australia, Asia and Europe.
At full production, the mine is forecast to also produce 250,000 tonnes of lead and 100,000 tonnes of zinc a year.
